page.layout: One printed page (right). Running head at top centre. Main text in one block of running prose, then a centred heading with a Greek subtitle, then a synopsis diagram in braces, ending with the gathering signature below. The left edge of the scan shows the neighbouring page's margin, which is not transcribed.

main_text.p: Ecclesia contra omnes Diaboli tyrannorum & Sophistarum furores, potenter & mirando modo defendenda, & ad finem usque mundi conservanda. III Vivam verae Ecclesiae faciem, eiusque reformandae rationem nobis hic liber delineat, ad quam omnes Ecclesiae se conformare debeant. IV De efficacia ministerij Verbi, impios convertentis, corda penetrat, &c: V In exemplis fidelium Ecclesiae ministrorum, quid nostri, qui ad idem munus vocamur, sit officij in allegandis & explicandis S. scripturis, & in totius functione muneris. De hoc libro vere dici potest esse hanc historiam magistram vitae &c.
main_text.head: DISTRIBUTIO SEU SYNOPSIS
main_text.l: Omnium in genere, doctrina, facta, eve-ta[?]. De ipso rū Ministerio in plā-tanda Ecclesia
Duorū adscititiorū Pauli & Barnabæ: hīc de iis quæ
Inter Iudaeos nominatim Ierosolymis: de Apostolorum
Ab utroque Paulo & Barnabae simul gesta sunt.cap.13.14.15. ubi prima Pauli peregrinatio.

page.notes: The Greek subtitle is uncertain at its ending. The numerals III, IV and V before the theses are read as printed in roman type. The diagram is a bracketed synopsis; levels follow the braces. The left margin fragment (the edge of the previous page) is not transcribed.
